controls: Same bounded positive-credit rule, ACK gate, 2 s retirement, 128-record capacity and frozen actor; proof frames ignored as evidence in every arm. Proof-generation toggles traffic. Censored versus naive toggles expiry penalty and late-evidence handling.
analysis: One paired contrast per fixture. Proof traffic effects within each evidence mode and duty: 12 tests. Evidence-mode effects within each proof/duty: 12 tests. Interaction within duty: 6 tests. One 30-test Holm family; unadjusted paired t confidence intervals. No equivalence test or original acceptance-gate claim.
technical_pilot: An initial 88001 batch stopped on an unhandled proof callback. The correction ignores proof events as already specified; the partial 88001 captures are excluded. A 76901 technical pilot is excluded from inference.
